description: A dedicated-storage migration creating an object OUTSIDE the plugin's `plugin_<normalizedId>_` namespace MUST be refused with exit 2, and the kernel MUST NOT rewrite the name to make it fit. The fixture is identical to `plugin-storage-prefix-enforced` except the table is unprefixed, so the refusal can only come from the namespace rule. Refusal rather than injection is the contract because the alternative silently creates a table whose name appears nowhere in the author's source; the same rule is what stops a migration from reaching a `state_*` kernel table, which fails on this identical check rather than a separate one.
